Application For Prove Up Hearing
Off Calendar Aug-28-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Judge: K. Tsenin, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Maria Viscio #12353.

Michael Raifsnider, Esq. appeared for plaintiff Peter Castro, Trusteeof the Peter Castro Trust Created on Sept. 21, 2000.
Plaintiff Witness Peter Castro, was placed under oath and direct examined.
No appearance by defaulted defendants Saratoga Bancorp and Amarjit S. Ahluwalia aka Amarjit S. Walia.
Default of Defendant(s) has been duly entered.
After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendants as follows:

Principal - $503,393.33
Prejudgment Interest - $28,883.19
Costs - $855.00 for a total judgment in the amount of $533,131.52
Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
